Trump Jr's firm leads $1 billion Polymarket raise at $21 billion value: Report
articles.snippet: 1789 Capital is putting in about $300 million, adding to a roughly $200 million stake, as the prediction market's valuation rises from $15 billion.

articles.title: Kalshi issues first lifetime ban for Republican politician over insider bets
articles.snippet: The prediction platform permanently banned George Santos and issued a three-year suspension for Laurie Buckhout after investigations into using insider information on event contracts.

articles.title: Trump Jr.-linked 1789 Capital leads Polymarket’s $1B raise: Report
articles.snippet: Donald Trump Jr.-linked 1789 Capital will reportedly lead a $1 billion investment round into Polymarket, which would value the platform at $21 billion, just below Kalshi’s $22 billion valuation.

articles.title: South Korea Arrests Four Over Crypto Payments to Syrian Terror Group
articles.snippet: Police say the ringleader also took crypto from the group and sent back 11 used cars and two excavators, a first for Korean investigators.
